source_metadata.title: Cardiovascular disease risk with integrase inhibitor-based antiretroviral therapy: A causal inference analysis in RESPOND
source_metadata.source_type: major journal article; multi-cohort observational causal-inference analysis using target trial emulation

source_conflicts_or_version_issues.issue: Results prose on page 9 gives RR 1.07 with lower CI 0.20, whereas the abstract and Table 2 give lower CI 0.29.
source_conflicts_or_version_issues.resolution_for_extraction: The quantitative atom uses Table 2/abstract value 1.07 (95% CI 0.29–4.93); the discrepancy is retained here rather than silently reconciled.

source_conflicts_or_version_issues.issue: The abstract on page 2 gives RR 1.30 with lower CI 1.07, whereas the Results prose and Table 2 give lower CI 1.03.
source_conflicts_or_version_issues.resolution_for_extraction: The quantitative atom uses the Table 2/Results value 1.30 (95% CI 1.03–1.62); the discrepancy is retained here rather than silently reconciled.

extraction_limitations: The uploaded PDF references supplementary tables and figures, but the supplement itself was not included in the 26-page file; supplement-only assertions were not extracted.

Atoms prioritize independently reviewable study design, population, exposure/comparator, outcome, primary Table 2 estimates, subgroup/sensitivity findings, conclusions, limitations, funding, conflicts, and data availability rather than reproducing every baseline table cell.
No causal claim was added beyond the source wording; observational estimates were represented as adjusted risk estimates or associations.
All atoms are marked needs_review because extraction was performed by a language model and not independently human-verified.

atoms.canonical_statement: The study aimed to estimate the effect of INSTI-based ART on cardiovascular disease risk in treatment-naïve and treatment-experienced people with HIV in RESPOND using target trial emulation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we performed a target trial emulation to estimate the impact of INSTI-based ART on CVD risk

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-naïve eligibility required age at least 18 years.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Treatment-naïve individuals had to be ≥18 years

population.label: Treatment-naïve target-trial population

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-naïve eligibility required being ART-naïve after January 2012.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: ART-naïve after January 2012

population.label: Treatment-naïve target-trial population

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-naïve eligibility required detectable HIV viral load of at least 200 copies/mL and recent CD4 and viral-load measurements.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: have a detectable HIV viral load (≥200 cp/mL), and CD4 and viral load measurements

population.label: Treatment-naïve target-trial population
inclusion_criteria: CD4 and HIV viral-load measurements within one year before or up to 12 weeks after ART start

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-naïve individuals with missing gender/sex, unknown ART, or initial maraviroc or enfuvirtide were excluded.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Individuals with missing data on gender/sex, who started unknown ART or who started maraviroc or enfuvirtide

population.label: Treatment-naïve target-trial population

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-experienced eligibility required INSTI-free ART after January 2012, no prior INSTI exposure, suppressed HIV viral load below 200 copies/mL, and no history of cardiovascular disease.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: on INSTI-free ART after January 2012 without prior exposure to INSTIs and have a suppressed HIV viral load

population.label: Treatment-experienced target-trial population

atoms.canonical_statement: The treatment-naïve analysis included 7111 individuals; 19% were women, 8.5% were Black, median age at ART initiation was 38 years (IQR 31–47), and 56% had MSM as the reported HIV acquisition mode.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Overall, 1341 (19%) were women, 601 (8.5%) were Black people, the median age at ART start was 38 years

population.label: Treatment-naïve included population

atoms.canonical_statement: Among treatment-naïve participants, 3354 (47%) started INSTI-based ART and 3757 (53%) started other ART.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Started INSTI 3354 (47%)

population.label: Treatment-naïve included population

atoms.canonical_statement: The treatment-experienced analysis included 22921 unique people with HIV; 28% were female, 12% were Black, and median age at baseline was 49 years (IQR 41–56).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we included 22’921 people with HIV

population.label: Treatment-experienced included population

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-experienced participants contributed to a median of 57 sequential trials (IQR 32–94) and had a median follow-up of 37 months (IQR 18–63).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Individuals contributed to a median of 57 trials (IQR 32–94) and were followed for a median of 37 months

population.label: Treatment-experienced included population

atoms.canonical_statement: In the treatment-naïve analysis, the exposure strategy was initiation of an INSTI-based ART regimen regardless of additional NNRTI or protease-inhibitor components.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: classified as initiating either an INSTI-based ART regimen–regardless of additional components

exposures.details: Initiation of an ART regimen containing an integrase strand transfer inhibitor.

atoms.canonical_statement: In the treatment-naïve analysis, the comparator strategy was initiation of ART without an INSTI.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: or ART without INSTI

exposures.details: Initiation of antiretroviral therapy without an integrase strand transfer inhibitor.

atoms.canonical_statement: In the treatment-experienced analysis, the exposure strategy was switching from INSTI-free ART to an INSTI-based regimen; switching between different INSTIs was allowed.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: switching to an INSTI-based

exposures.details: Treatment-experienced participant switched from INSTI-free ART to an INSTI-based regimen.

atoms.canonical_statement: In the treatment-experienced analysis, the comparator strategy was continuing INSTI-free ART; switches among non-INSTI regimens were permitted.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: continuing INSTI-free regimen

exposures.details: Treatment-experienced participant remained on ART without an INSTI; switches among non-INSTI regimens were permitted.

atoms.canonical_statement: Among treatment-naïve participants who started INSTI-based ART, 55.1% started dolutegravir, 19.4% elvitegravir, 17% raltegravir, 8.5% bictegravir, and 0.03% cabotegravir.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the majority started dolutegravir (n=1820, 55.1%)

concept.text: INSTI agents initiated in treatment-naïve participants

exposures.details: Dolutegravir 55.1%; elvitegravir 19.4%; raltegravir 17%; bictegravir 8.5%; cabotegravir 0.03%.

atoms.canonical_statement: Among treatment-experienced participants who switched to INSTIs, 58% received dolutegravir, 18.1% elvitegravir, 16.1% raltegravir, 7.6% bictegravir, and 0.1% cabotegravir.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the majority received dolutegravir (n = 6558, 58%)

concept.text: INSTI agents after switch in treatment-experienced participants

exposures.details: Dolutegravir 58%; elvitegravir 18.1%; raltegravir 16.1%; bictegravir 7.6%; cabotegravir 0.1%.

atoms.canonical_statement: The outcome was time to first cardiovascular disease event, defined as fatal or non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, or an invasive cardiovascular procedure including coronary angioplasty/stenting, coronary bypass surgery, or carotid stenting/endarterectomy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The outcome of interest was time to first CVD event, including fatal and non-fatal myocardial infarctions, strokes

outcome.definition: Fatal or non-fatal myocardial infarction, stroke, coronary angioplasty or stenting, coronary bypass surgery, carotid artery stenting, or carotid endarterectomy.
outcome.measurement_method: Standardized case report forms with central physician validation using established algorithms.

atoms.canonical_statement: RESPOND is a collaboration of 19 cohorts of people with HIV across Europe and Australia, with clinical and laboratory data prospectively recorded in local cohorts and shared annually using standardized protocols.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: RESPOND is a collaboration of 19 cohorts of people with HIV across Europe and Australia

atoms.canonical_statement: For treatment-naïve participants, baseline was the start date of the initial ART regimen.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Baseline was defined as the start date of the initial ART regimen for treatment-naïve individuals

atoms.canonical_statement: For treatment-experienced participants, a new target trial was emulated each month from January 2012 through December 2021, with eligibility and baseline covariates reassessed at each trial start and overlapping trials pooled.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: a new trial was emulated each month between January 2012 and December 2021

atoms.canonical_statement: The intention-to-treat analysis followed participants until the earliest of cardiovascular event, death, loss to follow-up, or final cohort visit; absence of an HIV viral-load measurement for at least 18 months defined loss to follow-up.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: participants were followed from baseline until earliest of CVD event, death, loss to follow-up, or final cohort visit

atoms.canonical_statement: Per-protocol analyses artificially censored participants when they deviated from their assigned treatment strategy.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: participants were artificially censored when they deviated from their assigned treatment strategy

atoms.canonical_statement: Intention-to-treat analyses used pooled logistic regression to estimate cardiovascular risk differences and risk ratios, with linear and quadratic exposure-by-time product terms.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we used pooled logistic regression to estimate risk differences and risk ratios

atoms.canonical_statement: Confounding adjustment used stabilized inverse-probability of treatment weights estimated with pooled logistic regression.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: we used stabilized inverse-probability of treatment weights

atoms.canonical_statement: Per-protocol treatment-naïve analyses additionally used inverse-probability of censoring weights, and treatment-experienced per-protocol analyses used cumulative inverse-probability of treatment weights across sequential trials.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: calculate inverse-probability of censoring weights

atoms.canonical_statement: All analysis weights were truncated at the 99th percentile to limit the influence of extreme weights.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All weights were truncated at the 99th percentile

atoms.canonical_statement: The study calculated 95% confidence intervals using 500 bootstrap samples and handled missing covariate data with missingness indicators rather than imputation.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We calculated 95% confidence intervals (CI) using bootstrapping with 500 samples

atoms.canonical_statement: Treatment-experienced subgroup analyses evaluated gender, age below versus at least 65 years, and baseline abacavir use; sensitivity analyses included parametric g-computation, restriction to trials starting after January 2017, and restriction to cohorts sharing all participant data with RESPOND.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Subgroup analyses were performed by gender (female, male), age (<65, ≥65 years), and whether the baseline ART included ABC

atoms.canonical_statement: During a median 62 months of follow-up in the treatment-naïve analysis, 95 cardiovascular events occurred: 38 myocardial infarctions, 37 strokes, and 20 invasive cardiovascular procedures.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: During a median follow-up of 62 months (IQR 36–85), 95 CVD events occurred

atoms.canonical_statement: During treatment-experienced follow-up, 800 unique cardiovascular events occurred: 311 myocardial infarctions, 256 strokes, and 233 invasive cardiovascular procedures.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: During this follow-up, 800 unique CVD events occurred: 311 myocardial infarctions
